title: Kentucky appeals court finds no threat, overturns woman's stalking protection order
summary_full: In Kentucky, Abigail Taylor Harbin alleged that Billie West engaged in stalking behavior stemming from incidents at Chuck E. Cheese, linked to family disputes during her aunt's divorce from David Hensley. Despite her claims of repeated harassment, the Court of Appeals found insufficient evidence of actual threats and ruled that the family court had overstepped by granting the protection order, ultimately dismissing Harbin's petition against West.
